user_review.method: Maintainer followed the public demo and CLI on real macOS filesystems; three synthetic task contexts and failure/recovery regression cases. Not an independent user study.

scenarios.request: Organize a task containing an approved result, a redundant download, a necessary runtime copy and rejected history.
scenarios.expected: Repair the entry, preserve distinct purposes, prove undo, and leave a usable current result.
scenarios.observed: Executed design, release and research demos; each passed apply, link check, exact visible-file rollback and final artifact reconciliation. Final public-command demo reran after refinements.

scenarios.request: Apply after external edits, an occupied destination, a new reference, a symlink or a corrupt preimage.
scenarios.expected: Reject conflicting work without overwriting new content.
scenarios.observed: Executable cases pass for source/survivor edits, new and edited referring files, occupied paths, symlinks and corrupted recovery bytes.

scenarios.request: Resume or undo a partially completed operation.
scenarios.expected: Retain source content and recover without replaying destructive actions.
scenarios.observed: Simulated process interruption inside real filesystem tests after a write and before journal completion; resume, partial rollback and interrupted rollback tests pass.

scenarios.request: Resume an existing task without deep organization, or answer a tiny question.
scenarios.expected: Keep existing resume bounded; no mandatory artifact catalog or whole-workspace inventory.
scenarios.observed: Existing 16 task identity/retrieval tests pass; instruction review keeps ordinary entry lightweight and optional organization separate. No independent agent-trigger study claimed.

similar_skills.learned: Choose the right persisted task, reconcile live work and retained state, and use relevant evidence on return.
similar_skills.reason: Keep selected task recovery and evidence links. Do not copy host-specific hooks, universal tool-call counters or unrelated planning rules.

similar_skills.learned: Separate filesystem facts from semantic judgments; preview changes and preserve complete recovery content.
similar_skills.reason: Apply explicit evidence, dry-run and preimages to task artifacts. Do not broaden TaskDock into installed-skill curation or infer value from usage counts.

validation.observed: 36 tests passed on macOS; Windows/Linux platform behavior is not claimed as verified. Fixed macOS /var versus /private/var root resolution found during first execution.
Three sample contexts and a final README-command run completed; original visible file bytes restored and organized result reconciled.
Skill structure and public product-page checks passed. Workflow SVG rendered and visually inspected without clipping. No growth claims.
